articles.title: Fertility technology alone won't reverse global fertility decline, experts warn
articles.excerpt: Advances in fertility medicine have helped millions to have children—but a new international review published in Frontiers in Science has concluded that such treatments are unlikely to reverse the worldwide fall in fertility rates on their own.
articles.summary: 一篇发表于 Frontiers in Science 的国际综述指出，生育医学进步虽已帮助数百万家庭生育，但仅靠生育技术不太可能逆转全球生育率下降。
